requirements.statement: The submission defines the exact golden12_axis_fifo parameter and port contract.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The supplied repository dependency and submitted wrapper elaborate together without modifying existing files.
requirements.verification_intent: Implemented development-visible compile and scope checks; runner freeze remains pending.

requirements.statement: The wrapper structurally instantiates the supplied axis_fifo dependency with the frozen frame-FIFO configuration.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Elaborated hierarchy and parameter bindings show one axis_fifo instance with KEEP, LAST, FRAME_FIFO, and oversize-drop enabled and optional metadata disabled.
requirements.verification_intent: Implemented development-visible elaboration checks plus planned private synthesis hierarchy inspection.

requirements.statement: Accepted non-oversized frames preserve data, byte-valid masks, boundaries, and ordering.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The output frame sequence exactly equals the accepted input frame sequence for tdata, tkeep, and tlast.
requirements.verification_intent: Directed visible comparison and development hidden seeded differential; neither is frozen.

requirements.statement: Output payload and metadata remain stable under sink backpressure.
requirements.acceptance_rule: No m_axis signal covered by the interface contract changes while valid is high and ready is low, absent sampled reset.
requirements.verification_intent: Deterministic visible and development hidden seeded stall checks.

requirements.statement: Source and sink stalls do not cause loss, duplication, or reordering.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Alternating and prolonged independent stalls preserve the accepted-to-emitted frame sequence.
requirements.verification_intent: Public deterministic stalls and development hidden seeded backpressure.

requirements.statement: Partial frames are withheld from the output.
requirements.acceptance_rule: No beat from a frame becomes output-valid before that frame has been accepted through tlast.
requirements.verification_intent: Implemented development-visible partial-frame hold check plus private differential calibration; neither is frozen.

requirements.acceptance_rule: A frame larger than DEPTH_BYTES produces no output prefix and exactly one status_overflow pulse when it terminates.
requirements.verification_intent: Implemented development-visible oversize sequence plus private boundary calibration; neither is frozen.

requirements.statement: A committed good frame produces a one-cycle status_good_frame pulse.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Each accepted, completed, non-dropped frame produces one pulse and no other event produces a pulse.
requirements.verification_intent: Implemented development-visible status-event checks plus private seeded calibration; neither is frozen.

requirements.statement: Synchronous active-high reset flushes complete and partial buffered frames.
requirements.acceptance_rule: After a sampled reset, output valid and status pulses are low and no pre-reset beat is later emitted.
requirements.verification_intent: Development reset-during-partial and reset-during-output-stall parameter tests.

requirements.statement: Representative legal widths and capacities preserve the same protocol contract.
requirements.acceptance_rule: DATA_WIDTH values 8, 32, and 64 with at least two legal beat capacities elaborate and pass the applicable behavior checks.
requirements.verification_intent: Development hidden P2P sweep at DATA_WIDTH 8, 32, and 64; not frozen.

requirements.acceptance_rule: Non-byte-aligned DATA_WIDTH, non-integral capacity, or non-power-of-two beat capacity causes elaboration or equivalent static failure.
requirements.verification_intent: Implemented development-visible negative elaboration probes plus private parameter probes; neither is frozen.

requirements.statement: The submission remains within the one-file additive scope.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Only rtl/golden12_axis_fifo.sv is added; the supplied axis_fifo dependency and all other repository files remain byte-identical.
requirements.verification_intent: Submission manifest and repository-base digest validation.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: input and output handshakes on the same rising edge
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: Both independent transfers occur; frame and beat order remain unchanged.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: input valid while input ready is low
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: No input transfer occurs and FIFO state does not consume the beat.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: output valid while output ready is low
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: No output transfer occurs and output payload plus metadata remain stable.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: sampled reset coincides with either handshake expression
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: Reset wins; neither transfer is retained.
